title: The Wi‑Fi Coffee Shop That Started a Trend

scenes.text: The 1994 coffee shop that launched public Wi‑Fi

scenes.label: EARLY 802.11 CARD
scenes.text: It used a prototype 802.11 card built by a university lab

scenes.label: FREE INTERNET HOURS
scenes.text: Customers could browse the web for two free hours each day

scenes.label: INSPIRING CAFE NETWORKS
scenes.text: The concept sparked dozens of cafés across the US within a year
Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: A tiny Seattle café wired its tables with a prototype Wi‑Fi card, giving patrons free internet and igniting a café‑wide movement. Discover the humble start of public Wi‑Fi. Follow for more tech origin stories!
